Maria (Sales): Hey team — customer is requesting a fully air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed offline artifacts, clear cert rotation guidance, defined upgrade cadence (they want to know if we support quarterly patches vs ad-hoc hotfixes), and cost for a 6-week isolated POC. Any known blockers from packaging/ops/security?
Sam SE: We can support. Options: full offline bundle (images + operator + license), minibundle (only runtime + model shards) for smaller transfers, and delta patches for subsequent updates. Signed artifacts + SBOM is supported.
Natalie (InfoSec): Need specifics: signer key management (Redwood-managed vs customer HSM), SBOM format (CycloneDX preferred?), revocation/CRL approach for certs in an island, and offline attestation story. Also compliance checklist for legal.
Jamie (Ops): Installer flow we usually recommend: provide a signed tarball and a small bootstrap binary for the jumpbox. Customer imports certs/key material into their KMS or we supply an envelope-encrypted bundle. Typical bootstrap steps:
```
# on jumpbox
sha256sum redwood-poc-1.6.2-airgap.tar.gz
tar -xzf redwood-poc-1.6.2-airgap.tar.gz
sudo ./install.sh --offline --license /path/to/license.sig
```
We also support USB transfer or a secured scp from an internal staging host.
Sam SE: For upgrades we recommend: initial full bundle, then signed deltas for routine updates. We can target a 90-day nominal cadence (quarterly security + perf updates) with emergency hotfix push as a separate signed delta. Deltas are smaller and validated via signature + hash.
Natalie (InfoSec): Clarify signing: do we provide a public key to verify artifacts and a key rotation cadence? Also need guidance for cert rotation when there is no outbound CRL/OCSP access. Offline CRL distribution is possible but customer needs a process. Can we provide a signed CRL bundle they can import?
Jamie (Ops): Yes — we can produce a signed CRL bundle and a rotation playbook. Options:
- Customer-managed keys in HSM/KMS (recommended for enterprise)
- Redwood-managed signing key (we store in our KMS, provide verification public key)
Rotation: default 90 days, can be 30/60/180 depending on customer risk profile. For air-gapped, rotation requires delivering a new signed artifact and updating the local trust store.
Kevin (Sales Eng): Pricing question: for a 6-week isolated POC, do we do a flat POC fee + per-host runtime license? What's typical?
Sam SE: Typical commercial: small POC fee to cover offline packaging + support ($5-15k range historically), then per-host consumption for Dedicated/Private if they convert. We can also offer credits towards first commit for Dedicated. Exact depends on model licensing and number of GPUs/hosts.
Maria (Sales): Customer also asked about SBOM and SCA tooling integration for their security team — can we supply SBOM + vulnerability scan report for shipped artifacts?
Natalie (InfoSec): We can export SBOM (CycloneDX JSON) and run a one-off SCA scan (OSS vulnerability list). For third-party binaries inside the bundle we list component versions in the SBOM. They may require signed SBOMs — we can sign those too.
Jamie (Ops): Ops note: we need to confirm acceptable transport medium (USB, air-gapped sftp, courier) and certificate chain to embed. Also clarify whether they want image-level signing (cosign) or tarball PKCS7 signing. We support both; cosign recommended for containerized pieces.
Sam SE: Quick example verification for cosign artifacts: `cosign verify --key cosign.pub registry.example.com/redwood/runtime:1.6.2` — for the offline bundles we provide an equivalent `cosign verify-blob` flow.
deploy-bot: release 1.6.2-airgap signed by key id abc123def (sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924).
Natalie (InfoSec): One more: how do we handle emergency revocation in case a signing key is compromised while offline? We need a documented revocation plan that includes out-of-band signing key rotation and artifact re-signing procedures.
Jamie (Ops): We have a playbook: reprovision a new signing key, re-sign next delta as urgent hotfix, and ship a revocation bundle + truststore update. Time to recover depends on customer acceptance window — assume 24–72 hours for manual offsite handoff.
Kevin (Sales Eng): For the contract side, legal wants to know SLA commitments during an air-gapped POC. We should offer a targeted support window (M–F business hours) and an expedited option (24/7) as a billable add-on.
Maria (Sales): Action items: Sam — draft the technical one-pager (packaging options + signing + rotation) we can share with customer security. Jamie — prepare ops playbook snippet (bootstrap + delta apply + recovery). Natalie — list the exact artifacts we can sign and the recommended cadence for rotation. Kevin — propose POC commercial framework (fee ranges + add-ons).
Sam SE: Will do, aiming to drop a first draft by EOD tomorrow. @Natalie, Jamie — want your review before I share.
Natalie (InfoSec): Sounds good. I’ll add SBOM/signature language and a short checklist.
Jamie (Ops): I’ll include install commands and transport checklist.
Maria (Sales): Great — thanks everyone. I’ll coordinate with customer and set expectation for a 1-week turnaround on the one-pager. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Sales Eng): +1
Maria (Sales): tagging this for legal handoff once drafts are ready.
